messages:
Sam Chen: Hey team — Acme Search reporting that embeddings stopped working after they rotated API key. They get 403 with 'insufficient_scope'. Copied logs below.

Customer: Acme Search: We rotated keys last night per our SSO onboarding. Now /embeddings returns 403. Example curl:

Customer: Acme Search: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large-v2","input":"hello"}'
```

Customer: Acme Search: Response: `403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing scope: embeddings.create"}`

Priya Rao: Thanks for the report. Can you DM me the key id? Do you see the same error in the console for their requests? (sam @acme maybe share request ids)

Sam Chen: Request ids: req_01F8ABC123, req_01F8ABC456. I pulled logs, Support Bot match:

Support Bot: ```
[1798409123] api_request req_01F8ABC123 403 api.embeddings.create "insufficient_scope"
```

Evan Li: Quick hypothesis — looks like the service account got created with embeddings *read-only* or only 'embed:view' but not 'embed:create'. In our key provisioning flow there's a bug where SSO roles map to scopes incorrectly for newly provisioned keys.

Infra Oncall: Confirmed. I checked provisioning events for acct acme-search: user provisioned via SSO role 'analytics_read' which maps to scopes ['embeddings:view','models:read'] instead of ['embeddings:create','models:read'] — bug in map table.

Priya Rao: Ok. Two immediate remediation options: 1) issue new key with correct scopes, 2) update the existing key's scopes via admin console if customer is on enterprise plan. Which is viable for Acme?

Sam Chen: They are on SMB enterprise; they asked not to create extra keys. They do have a Corporate SSO-managed key; prefer scope patching.

Infra Oncall: We can patch scope server-side for enterprise. I can run: `PATCH /admin/keys/{key_id}` to add embeddings:create. Need approval from product for scope change for SSO-managed keys.

Priya Rao: @product — can we approve scope patch for SSO-provisioned keys? It's safe; this is a repro of our SSO mapping table bug.

Evan Li: Product note: if we patch, also update audit logs and notify customer. We should also fix the mapping so new keys don't have wrong scopes.

Product (via Support Bot): :white_check_mark: Approved for this customer. Please include note in changelog and cc security.

Sam Chen: Infra Oncall — go ahead. Also can you send the minimal steps for customer to test once done?

Infra Oncall: Patch applied to key id sk_ABC123. I refreshed token cache. Steps to verify:

Infra Oncall: ```
1) Re-run the curl above with same Authorization header
2) Expect 200 and embeddings array
3) If still 403, paste latest request id here
```

Customer: Acme Search: Re-tested — success ✅ We get 200, embeddings return. Thanks!

Sam Chen: Closing loop: root cause = SAML role map -> wrong scope mapping during SSO key creation (analytics_read -> embeddings:view only). Action items:
- Evan: PR to mapping table with unit test (due EOD)
- Infra: Add post-provision verification that checks for required scopes (due tom)
- Priya: Notify CS customers who recently rotated keys via SSO (small batch) and offer help

Priya Rao: I'll draft a short KB article for self-service fix and add a snippet for the Console UI to show scopes during rotation.

Sam Chen: Great. Tagging security for audit trail. :lock:

Support Bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-4567. Action items logged.

Evan Li: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3124 — mapping fix + test. :sparkles:

Sam Chen: Thanks everyone. Marking resolved. :thumbsup:
